notes: screens_min 2: the first screen is the opening's product panel, each further screen (or the film) is one stage card; with one screen and no film the stack has no stage at all.
An upright picture not used by a step stands beside the opening's screen; without it the screen stands alone.
plans: the price card with its segment switch is one of the reference's marks; without plans the section is left out whole.
made.land carries the opening, every stage, the price band (one lead picture, chosen by the page's tone) and the link cards (its neighbours). made.field carries the tiles.
links: each is a whole-width card with only a heading and a button — thin when links[].d is missing.
A place (restaurant, hotel, shop) is not a fit: no menu, hours, address or rooms.
